resources.string: The phone half of your assistant
Lets Felix press buttons and type for you, on request

Felix uses this to carry out actions you ask for: sending a new WhatsApp message, pressing Back or Home, tapping a control or typing text. It acts only when you or your own Felix Core request it and does not record what you do.
Shows that Felix is linked to your laptop
Briefs and other messages your assistant sends you
Pair this phone with Felix on your laptop to get started.
This phone was unpaired on the laptop. Pair it again to reconnect.
Your laptop has internet: Felix answers at full strength.
Your laptop is offline: Felix answers from its offline commands.
The laptop is not reachable right now. Felix keeps collecting messages and retries on its own.
On the laptop, open Felix and choose to pair a phone. Scan the code it shows with your camera app and this app opens ready to pair. You can also type the details shown next to the code.
The laptop could not be reached. Check that the phone and the laptop are on the same network and that Felix is running.
That pairing code is wrong, already used or expired. Ask Felix on the laptop for a new one.
Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try with a new code.
The laptop answered with an error (HTTP %1$d).
The connection dropped while pairing. The code may be used up: ask Felix on the laptop for a new one.
The connection is encrypted and locked to this laptop.
Warning: this link uses plain HTTP. Anyone on the same network could read what Felix and this phone exchange. Use it for testing only.
This phone is now linked to %1$s. Allow the permissions below so Felix can help.
Felix on the laptop will no longer receive messages from this phone or control it. Messages waiting to be sent are discarded.
Felix can only do what you allow here. Each item says what it is for; you can leave any of them off.
If Android says a setting is restricted, open app info, tap the three-dot menu and choose Allow restricted settings. Android asks for this once for apps installed outside the Play Store.
Android will not ask for this again. You can still allow it under Permissions in app info.
This phone does not offer that settings screen.
Read WhatsApp and other chat notifications, and answer them through their reply button.
Start a new WhatsApp message, press Back or Home, tap and type on request.
Show the floating Felix bubble, and open apps when Felix is asked to from the background.
Keep the link to your laptop alive while the screen is off.
Deliver briefs and messages from Felix.
Call or text people by name.
Read and manage the calendars synced to this phone.
Send texts for you and include incoming texts in summaries.
Place calls and tell Felix about missed calls.
Answer where the phone is. Allow twice: first while in use, then all the time.
Talk to Felix from the floating panel.
Switch silent mode and Do Not Disturb.
A small bubble stays on top of other apps. Tap it to type or speak to Felix; drag it to move it.
This phone is not paired with a laptop yet, so I can only do phone actions: flashlight, calls, texts, alarms, timers, volume and opening apps.
This phone is not paired with a laptop.
Felix on the laptop is out of reach
Felix did not return an answer.
Something went wrong on the phone (%1$s).
Felix on the laptop answered with an error (HTTP %1$d).
The connection to the laptop was lost before the answer was complete.
Allow the microphone in the Felix app to speak to me.
Speech recognition is not available on this phone.
I could not hear that. Try again or type it.
Pair with your laptop to see briefs here.
Only notifications from these apps are passed to Felix on your laptop.
No apps selected. Felix reads no notifications.
Felix Companion %1$s. This app talks only to the Felix Core you paired it with, over an encrypted connection pinned to that computer. It has no accounts, no analytics and no other servers.
